description: Full-text search over verified claims by host and symptom, e.g. "github per_page 500", "npm search size 0", "is latitude required on /v1/forecast": the lookup for an unexpected 4xx/5xx, a parameter that seems ignored, an odd page, or wrong filter results. Optionally restricted to one API (name, host or URL). Compact evidence unless verbose=true.

tool.description: tool name (e.g. github-rest), or the host / URL you are about to call (e.g. api.github.com)

name: search_claims
title: Search claims
